overview: Deduction, conditional statements (if-then), seating/ordering puzzles, box-labelling puzzles, pattern/figure completion.
coreConcept: Statement ke sirf necessarily true consequences lo; 'if P then Q' ka contrapositive 'if not Q then not P' equivalent hai.
hinglishExplanation: Conditional 'jab teacher room me hai to sab students chup khade hain' ka matlab: agar teacher hai to students chup. Converse (agar students chup hain to teacher hai) NECESSARILY true nahi. Ordering puzzles me sab observations ko chain me likho.
formalDefinition: Statement ke sirf necessarily true consequences lo; 'if P then Q' ka contrapositive 'if not Q then not P' equivalent hai.
importantProperties: If P then Q = if not Q then not P (contrapositive).
Ordering: relations ko chain me jodo.
Box-labelling: sab labels galat hain to ek pick se solve.
Necessarily true = har case me true.
